name: C · Bone with a navy frame
css: body .status, body .nav-inline { background: var(--fort-navy); color: #f6f1e8; } body.dark .status, body.dark .nav-inline { background: #050c17; } body .nav-inline .back, body .nav-inline .glass-btn { color: #f6f1e8; } body .nav-inline .glass-btn { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .1); box-shadow: none; } body .tabbar { background: var(--fort-navy); border-color: var(--fort-idle); } body.dark .tabbar { background: #050c17; } body .tabbar .tab { color: var(--fort-label); } body .tabbar .tab.on { color: var(--fort-orange-text); background: rgb(255 255 255 / .08); } .scroll { padding-top: 14px; }
